verdict.rationale: Orama's open-source engine runs fully in-process/client-side (orama-probe-rt-1), meaning data never has to leave the user's own infrastructure, and Orama Cloud explicitly offers on-premise deployment 'on your own infrastructure' (orama-docs-8), giving users some control over data location. However there is no documented region-selection feature or list of hosted regions for the managed Orama Cloud SaaS offering itself. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selector or documented list of cloud hosting regions for Orama Cloud, independent verification of on-premise deployment claims
